disambiguation: Not a simple dashboard; it presents vault data through a thematic, interactive starfield visualization.
extras: Local, read-only, requires no Dataview setup.
intentEvidence: Cosmos Homepage turns an ordinary vault into a personal knowledge observatory.
problem: Users often struggle to get a high-level, calm overview of their vault's activity, unfinished tasks, and recurring themes without complex database setups or workflow changes.
summary: Cosmos Homepage transforms a standard Obsidian vault into an interactive, local knowledge observatory using a thematic starfield interface.
